flags.message: The separately provisioned decision-below.txt front page says Decided June 4, 2025, although its filing headers say June 4, 2026 and its argument date is September 10, 2025. The petition, snapshot, and amended opinion in appendix.txt consistently identify June 4, 2026 (amended June 8, 2026). The appeal numbers and substantive decision match. Forecast relies on the filed amended appendix and the provisioned 2026 chronology; no outcome information was retrieved.
